title: Courses
intro: Hands-on courses to learn by building real projects: videos at your own pace, live sessions to ask your questions, and support until you get results.
paymentNote: Pay by card through the platform, or by Mobile Money (Flooz, T-Money) directly on WhatsApp. Access sent within 24 h.

items.title: Laravel from A to Z
items.tagline: From your first route to deployment: build a complete application, step by step.
items.description: You learn Laravel by building a real management app: authentication, roles, REST API, Mobile Money payments and deployment. Each module ends with a working feature, and the live sessions help you get unstuck on your own project.
items.liveSessions: 4 live sessions of 2 h (Q&A, code review, exercise walkthroughs)
outcomes: Build a complete Laravel application, from models to UI
Set up authentication, roles and permissions
Build a clean, secure REST API
audience: Computer science students who want a solid project for their defense
PHP developers moving to a modern framework
Freelancers who want to ship faster and cleaner
prerequisites: A computer with at least 4 GB of RAM

modules.title: Going to production
lessons: Deploying to shared hosting or a VPS

faq.question: How long do I have access?
I'm new to PHP, can I follow along?
faq.answer: You need PHP basics. If you're unsure, message me on WhatsApp and we'll figure it out.

faq.question: How do the live sessions work?
faq.answer: Small-group video calls. You ask questions, we go over exercises and look at your code. Replays are available.

items.title: Django + Tailwind
items.tagline: Build modern, polished Django apps with Tailwind CSS, all the way to production.
items.description: A project-based course: you build a complete Django application with a modern Tailwind CSS interface, a dashboard, an API and a deployment. The live sessions help you apply it to your own project.
items.liveSessions: 3 live sessions of 2 h (Q&A, code review)
outcomes: Build modern interfaces with Tailwind CSS
Handle users, forms and the Django admin
Build an API with Django REST Framework
audience: Students who want a modern Python project
Python developers moving into web development
Developers who want great UIs without fighting CSS

faq.question: How long do I have access?
Do I need to know Tailwind first?
faq.answer: No, we start Tailwind from scratch.
